autonomous_bug_hunting_platform.live_verification: Two prominent actions implemented (START BUG HUNTING & CUSTOM BUG HUNT). 6 specialized security droids deployed (Argus-01, Hydra-02, Aegis-03, Vulcan-04, Specter-05, Cerberus-06). Program scope enforcement validates in-scope vs out-of-scope targets. Independent verification generates reproducible curl PoCs and cryptographic SHA-256 evidence seals. Markdown reports formatted for HackerOne & Bugcrowd VRT.

authentication_and_multi_provider.live_verification: PBKDF2 SHA-512 password hashing (100,000 iterations), Google Identity Services OAuth 2.0, GitHub OAuth, honest provider status auditing for Microsoft and Apple without false claims, account linking/unlinking, and safe multi-tenant account switching with CSRF & session expiry protection.

user_workspaces_and_isolation.live_verification: Strict tenant isolation on server-side queries. User workspaces contain isolated bug hunts, verified findings, tool configs, and program connections. Cross-tenant access rejected with 403 Forbidden.

continuity_and_intelligence_engine.live_verification: Durable engineering memories with evidence status (VERIFIED, INFERRED, UNVERIFIED, OUTDATED), strict tenant & project isolation, safe learning pipeline, task resurrection without duplicate side effects, and empirical routing calibration.

central_brain_router.live_verification: Domain classification, capability scoring, DAG multi-agent planning with pre-task architectural constraint injection, and honest failover.

google_oauth.live_verification: Client-side GIS tokenClient initialized without secrets leakage. Requires live VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and browser consent dialog.

google_drive_backup.live_verification: Authoritative persistence retained in database/vault; remote Google Drive multipart synchronization active when GIS OAuth token is present.

postgresql_persistence.live_verification: Automated migrations defined for 10 tables including aiheaven_engineering_memories and aiheaven_task_outcomes. Seamless connection pool and remote SSL support ready upon DATABASE_URL configuration.
